title: Lightweight
text: Lightweight. Slightly disappointed with this runner. Although it's 100% cotton, it's really thin AND the print is only on 1 side. The stitching is perfect, the colors are very clean. Does shrink slightly.

product_metadata.title: DII Americana Stars Kitchen & Tabletop Collection 4th of July & Memorial Day Décor, Table Runner, 14x72
features: CREATE A BEAUTIFUL TABLE SETTING: Our Americana table runner measures 14x72” in size, appropriate for a table that can seat 4-8 people or layered for larger tables; Beautiful on it's own but also pair easily with other items in this collection
EASY CARE: 100% cotton; Machine washable, gentle cycle, tumble dry low. Low iron if needed. Mix and Match with our other red white and blue table decorations

ADDS A FINISHING TOUCH – A bright backdrop for celebrating the Fourth of July or lively summer gatherings, our DII Star Check Tabletop adds a touch of patriotic flair to any table and will coordinate well with your 4th of July table décor

ENHANCE YOUR HOME: Line your 4th of July feast with matching napkin and tablecloth to create the perfect place setting. It’s a fun accent to outdoor picnics, or to any meal wanting a spark of patriotism.

FOR MORE DÉCOR: DII offers delightful home products including cloth napkins, napkin rings, cloth tablecloths, table runners, placemats and home decor. Click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our collections or search "DII Tabletop".
description: DII 100% cotton tablecloths come in a variety of sizes. These tablecloths are perfect for picnics, 4th of July parties, summer BBQ, dinners, everyday use and more. DII offers a variety of prints and patterns, giving you numerous options for your next event or dinner party. All of DII cotton tablecloths have a 1 inch folded hem and mitered corners. These tablecloths are machine washable for easy clean up and use. DII offers delightful home products including matching napkin rings, placemats and home decor.
